title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Content AI & Recommendations
searchText: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Content AI & Recommendations Instacart We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Overview Instacart powers millions of shopping journeys every day across one of the largest online grocery catalogs in the world. Machine learning sits at the center of that experience, shaping how customers search, discover, and decide what to buy. Advances in generative AI create a rare opportunity to rethink how commerce works. Instead of traditional ranking pipelines alone, the next generation of shopping experiences will be powered by intelligent systems that help customers explore products, plan purchases, and discover what they need more naturally. We are looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help lead this transformation. In this role, you will define the technical vision for how machine learning powers the Instacart shopping journey and build systems that move beyond traditional search and recommendation approaches. You will help develop next generation shopping experiences using large language models, agentic AI systems, and large scale personalization. This is a hands-on IC and technical leadership role at the Director level with no people management responsibilities. You will shape long term technical direction while building production systems that serve millions of customers in real time. About the Job Define and drive the long term technical vision for Shopping ML across search, discovery, recommendations, and personalization. Lead development of AI systems that fundamentally improve how customers discover products and shop on Instacart. Architect large scale ML systems combining LLM reasoning, retrieval, ranking, recommendation models, and personalization. Build and operate production ML systems powering real time shopping experiences across millions of users and products. Identify foundational ML capabilities that unlock new customer experiences and accelerate experimentation across the organization. Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, and data science to shape technical strategy and roadmap. Influence company wide ML architecture and contribute to major technical initiatives across Instacart. Mentor senior/staff engineers through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on collaboration. About You Minimum Qualifications Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent industry experience. 10+ years building and operating large scale machine learning systems in production. Proven track record architecting ML systems that power core product experiences at global scale. Deep expertise in areas such as recommendation systems, ranking models, embeddings, representation learning, or search systems. Experience combining generative AI with traditional ML systems such as retrieval, ranking, and personalization. Experience designing ML platforms that support large scale experimentation, training, and deployment. Ability to influence senior engineering and product leaders and drive technical strategy. Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation systems for large consumer platforms. Expertise in large language models, agentic AI systems, or tool using AI architectures. Experience fine tuning and distilling LLMs for low latency production systems, balancing model quality, latency, and cost. Experience building ML infrastructure supporting large scale experimentation and model deployment. Background working on e-commerce, marketplaces, or large consumer platforms. Recognized technical leadership through publications, patents, conference talks, or open source contributions. Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please rea d more about our benefits offerings here . For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $313,000 — $330,500 USD WA $301,000 — $317,500 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $287,000 — $303,000 USD All other states $261,000 — $275,500 USD We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more...
